Looks like derangements. It's NOT derangements. 🔀

Arrange 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 in a row so that no number is immediately followed by the next one (no 12, 23, 34, 45, 56). How many ways? Integer answer. AIME / IOQM-level combinatorics.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: C, 6.
A circle touching both axes in the first quadrant has centre (r, r). Through (2, 1): (2 − r)² + (1 − r)² = r², so r² − 6r + 5 = 0, giving r = 1 or r = 5. Both circles work: 1 + 5 = 6. The big one is easy to miss!

Drop a metal rod through a magnetic field and it stops speeding up. How fast does it end up? 🧲⬇️

Rails 0.5 m apart, 0.2 Ω at the top, B = 0.4 T, a 20 g rod sliding down. Terminal speed? NSEP-level EMI.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: D, 62.5 Hz.
The wall hears 500 × 340/320 = 531.25 Hz and reflects it. The driver, moving towards the wall, hears 531.25 × 360/340 = 562.5 Hz. Beats = 562.5 − 500 = 62.5 Hz. The 2uf/v shortcut (58.8 Hz) is only approximate.

One density, one edge length, one hidden lattice. Can you find the atom's radius? 💎

M = 93 g/mol, cubic cell with a = 330 pm, density 8.55 g/cm³. Atomic radius? NSEC-level solid state.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: B, 6.
[Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻: low-spin d⁶, 0 unpaired. [Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺: high-spin d⁶, 4. [Ni(CN)₄]²⁻: square planar d⁸, 0. [NiCl₄]²⁻: tetrahedral d⁸, 2. Total = 6. Ligand strength AND geometry both matter.

10,000 kJ of sunlight is captured by grass. How much ends up as grasshopper? 🦗

Plants respire 40% of GPP. Grasshoppers eat 20% of the NPP, assimilate 50% and respire 60% of that. New grasshopper biomass? The 10% rule will betray you. NSEB-level ecology.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: A, 36 minutes.
Cells divide at random, so the fraction of cells in a phase = the fraction of the cycle it takes. Metaphase: 30/1000 = 3% of 20 h = 0.6 h = 36 min. Divide by ALL cells, not just the 200 dividing ones.
